# MsGamer — Paulina Lorné

> Personal portfolio of Paulina Lorné (MsGamer), Marketing Manager in gaming and tech. Former Nordic Marketing Manager at Bethesda Softworks (2021–2026). Lifelong gamer who drove AAA launches across the Nordics — Fallout, Starfield, DOOM, The Elder Scrolls, and more. Based in Sweden.
